articles.title: The 3D Printing Industry Has Been Declining for Years. FUGO Precision 3D Was Built to Fix What Caused It.
articles.mainIdea: The 3D Printing Industry Has Been Declining for Years. FUGO Precision 3D Was Built to Fix What Caused It.
articles.summary: PR Newswire: The 3D Printing Industry Has Been Declining for Years. FUGO Precision 3D Was Built to Fix What Caused It.. "The additive manufacturing industry has been losing ground for years, and everyone knows why," said Alexander Meseonznik, Co-Founder and CEO of FUGO Precision 3D. "Manufacturers keep raising the same complaints. Too much labor. Too many machines. Inconsistent quality. Material lock-ins. Post-processing that was supposed to be automated a long time ago. These aren't mysteries. They're engineering problems, and we built FUGO to solve them."
